BH-5003. A build note (the resolver's carried test-tamper ruling, or a ci-replan brief) is also the ledger row build_note/" " (pending -> consumed|relayed), so a build on a watcher box sees it and reads it once across boxes. The hub file state/build-notes/

/.md stays as its mirror. Fails open.

knobs.note: 1 = the resolver writes build notes to the ledger and the plan stage, the pool relay and the re-plan floor read it. 0 = main's behaviour: the hub file and the pool relay only, no row written, read or marked. Read by bn__on through lib_env_apply build-note-db, then ${BUILD_NOTE_DB:-1}.
